title: Oozy Resinous Greek Cobnuts Saganaki
description: A traditional Greek dish featuring cobnuts, cheese, and a resinous flavor, perfect for a sick day, this oozy saganaki is egg-free-friendly and sure to satisfy your cravings. It is a twist on the classic recipe with added cobnuts for extra flavor and texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped cobnuts and cook for 2 minutes until lightly toasted.
In a large bowl, combine the crumbled kefalograviera cheese, ouzo, honey, pine resin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked cobnut mixture to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a small baking dish and bake for 15 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and drizzle with lemon juice.
Serve the oozy resinous Greek cobnuts saganaki hot, garnished with additional cobnuts if desired.
